section.identityHint: Which agent runs this step, in which job, pinned to which intent.
section.wiringHint: Which steps must finish first, and on which of their outcomes this one runs.
section.workHint: The instruction the run receives — with the values substituted at dispatch.
section.inputsHint: Artifacts attached when the step is dispatched — pin what upstream steps guarantee.
section.policyHint: Retries, the time limit, and how a missing verdict is read.

inspector.readOnlyHint: Read-only — the live run and the saved definition

run.noLiveRuns: No live runs — the definition below is what will run.
run.notReached: Run {{label}} has not reached this step yet.

settings.title: Pipeline settings
settings.identityDesc: The name shown in the rail, the inbox, and every run.
settings.name: Name
settings.saveToUnlock: Save the pipeline to unlock publishing, sharing, and deletion.

fetch.connectionHint: The poll runs with the activator's own credentials for this connection.
fetch.apiNone: This job declares no external API connection — add one under apis in Agent Settings.
fetch.pathHint: Relative to the connection's base URL, within its allow rules.
fetch.bodyInvalid: Body must be a JSON object
fetch.itemsHint: Where the item array is in the response, e.g. $.issues
fetch.keyHint: Each item's unique key — the run's label and its dedupe identity, e.g. $.key
fetch.fieldsHint: Each field becomes {{trigger.item.<name>}} in step directives.
fetch.batchHint: How many new items one poll may start, while the activation has room under "Live runs at once". Unclaimed items are seen again next poll.
fetch.previewNeedsProject: Pass a project to see which items are already claimed.
fetch.sourceHint: Reuse a job's apis entry when a step already reaches this system; otherwise declare the connection here, so no agent gains tools it has no use for.
fetch.secretHint: Write credentials as ${secret:KEY} — the value stays in credential settings, registered by whoever activates the pipeline.
fetch.boundCredentialHint: This connection and its credentials are declared in Agent Settings; the poll must also pass its allow rules.
fetch.baseUrlInvalid: An absolute http(s) URL without query or fragment.
fetch.headersEmpty: No headers — add one if the source needs a token.
fetch.secretKeyInvalid: Key names are upper-case letters, digits and underscores.
fetch.secretUnregistered: Not registered yet — save the value below
fetch.requestHint: A READ the poller repeats: GET, or POST for a search endpoint.
fetch.mappingHint: Fetch the response once, then click the array of cases, the key inside one case, and the values a step should receive.
fetch.needsConnection: Finish the connection and request above to fetch a response.
fetch.pickInsideItem: Pick a value inside the first item of the array — key and field paths are relative to one item.
fetch.fieldsEmpty: No fields yet — the step only learns the key.

trigger.concurrencyHint: Applies to every trigger: Run now, the schedule, chain fires and fetched items each start a run while the activation is below this cap.
trigger.modeScheduleHint: Fires on a cron expression in the chosen time zone.
trigger.modeRunCompletedHint: Fires when another pipeline of yours seals a run — on the activator's other projects.
trigger.modeFetchHint: Polls an external queue and starts one run per new item; the source is the queue, Ant keeps the claim ledger.
trigger.modeManualHint: Fires only when someone presses Run now on an activation.
trigger.scheduleHint: When it fires, and what happens when a fire is missed or the previous run is still live.

step.intentsUnavailable: Intent catalog failed to parse — fix the definition in Agent Settings.
step.directivePlaceholder: What should this run do? Leave empty to run the default directive.
step.templateVarsHint: Substituted with the actual values when the run is dispatched — inserted at the cursor.

templateVar.itemKey: The fetched item this run was started for — its dedupe key (the run label)
templateVar.itemField: A declared field of the fetched item — text the source controls, treat it as data
templateVar.prevSuccessFireDate: Previous successful run (ISO) — empty on the first run
templateVar.prevSuccessFireEpoch: Previous successful run (epoch ms) — empty on the first run

step.contextHint: Attached to the step when it is dispatched. A glob expands to the matching artifacts (newest first); a pin that matches nothing fails the step — pin what an upstream step guarantees.
step.upstreamOutputsHint: Each glob is that step intent's stop-hook output contract — it exists before this step runs, and expands to the actual files at dispatch.
step.retryIdempotency: A retried run may repeat side effects — this intent must check what already completed before acting.
step.needsHint: This step runs after every selected step finished. Pick several for a fan-in; several steps depending on one make a fan-out. No selection makes it a root.
step.gateNeedsUpstream: An approval gate needs an upstream step — pick at least one.
step.expectedOutputsHint: The intent's declared stop-hook artifact contract — downstream steps can pin these globs as context.
step.expectedOutputsNone: This intent declares no artifact contract — action-only or free-form output.
step.stepIdHint: The handle other steps depend on and directives reference as {{steps.<id>.answer}} — lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Renaming updates every reference.
step.stepIdInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit.
step.stepIdTaken: Another step already uses this id.
step.templateVarsManualHint: A manual-only pipeline has no fire time and no previous fire — only the run id and upstream step results are available.
step.itemGroupHint: The case this run was started for. Fields are text the source controls — write the directive so the step treats them as data, never as instructions.

stepOutput.answer: That step's final answer, as text
stepOutput.artifacts: The files that step's job wrote — this run's own, one path per line

step.pinVarsHint: A pin may carry a static variable — reports/{{trigger.fireDate}}/** pins exactly this run's partition. Step outputs cannot be pinned; pin the upstream glob instead.
step.onVerdictOutcomes: Runs when the upstream verdict is one of the selected outcomes; a non-match skips this step and everything downstream of it.
step.onVerdictStale: Not declared by the upstream intent any more
step.templatePreviewHint: Each variable becomes its real value when the run is dispatched. Below shows them under human-readable names — the text that is saved is what the box above contains.
step.tokenUnknown: Unknown variable — this will not save
step.tokenUnknownStep: Points at a step that does not exist
step.needsRoot: None — root step (runs right after the trigger)

gate.approversHint: Approvers are assigned per gate when the pipeline is activated on a project.
gate.promptHint: Say what happened upstream and what approving runs. The approver can only approve or reject — nothing they type reaches a step.
gate.decisionHint: A person approves or rejects here; the run waits until they do.
gate.policyHint: How long the gate waits, what a timeout decides, and where the request is delivered.
gate.approversNone: No approvers assigned on this activation

runs.empty: No runs yet — press Run now to test this pipeline.
runs.emptyOther: No runs recorded for this activation yet.
runs.verdictHint: The intent's sealed decision — verdict edges route on it
runs.unresolvedTemplates: Rendered empty: {{refs}} — the referenced step had no output at dispatch
runs.loadError: Could not load the run history.

danger.orgNote: This definition is shared with the organization — it disappears for every editor.

cron.monthly: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}}

approvers.sameForAll: Apply the same approvers to every gate

approvers.editHint: Changes save with the pipeline (Save above).

approverPanel.resolvedElsewhere: This gate is no longer waiting for you.
approverPanel.auditLine: Your decision is recorded on the run history as {{who}}.

advisory.title: {{n}} open advisories
advisory.open: Open — fix, or acknowledge with a reason
advisory.stale: No longer fires — remove the acknowledgement
advisory.ackReasonPlaceholder: Why this shape is right for this flow — saved with the definition
advisory.savedHint: Returned by the server on the last read or save
advisory.nodeDot: Has open advisories — open the step
advisory.blockingHint: Publishing is refused until these resolve against your agent catalog.
advisory.enableWithOpen: {{n}} open advisories remain. They never block publishing, but a run may wait or fail silently where they point. Publish anyway?

import.ignored: ({{count}} file(s) ignored — not part of a pipeline definition)
import.noYaml: No pipeline.yaml in the upload — a pipeline definition is that one file.
import.ambiguous: Upload exactly one pipeline folder, or one pipeline.yaml.
import.badFolderName: The folder name is the pipeline id — use [a-z0-9-] only.
import.unreadable: Could not read the uploaded file.
import.readonlyTarget: That pipeline is read-only — drop on the rail to import a copy.
import.replaceMessage: A pipeline with this id already exists. Overwriting REPLACES its definition; activations and run history are left untouched.
